title: Form squash landing chains from landed jobs only
summary: The gate's squash check treats every job whose closing records a commit adds as part of the chain, including rejected jobs such as pf6d. Their retry 1r97 then looks like a fork. Only jobs whose outcome is landed should be chained and judged.

defaults_applied.how: Add gate tests for a squash holding a rejected job, its landed retry and a follow-up job. Run cargo test and clippy.
Change the gate's job selection and its tests. Touch docs only where the design states the rule.
Recovered the cause from the error text in invariant.rs and landing_tests.rs.
Add a short note in the design doc or decisions.md, written for an outside reader.

assumptions: `closing_jobs` in crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs collects rejected jobs as well as landed ones. That is the cause of both errors. I read only that function and `chain_problem`.

A rejected or otherwise non-landed job in a squash is ignored for the chain. A job's previous_job may point at a rejected job. The chain head then has a previous job that is not in the commit and did not land on the parent. The check must allow that case without opening a hole for unlanded work.
The records of a rejected job still ship in the squash. The gate must not require them to chain.
Whether a job is landed is read from its outcome.json or outcome-landed.json in the commit tree, as `landed_at` does.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test in crates/athena-gate/src/landing_tests.rs builds a squash with a rejected job A, its landed retry B (previous_job = A) and a landed job C that follows B. The gate accepts it. Run `cargo test -p athena-gate`.
A squash of landed jobs that really fork is still refused with 'both follow'. The existing fork tests pass. Run `cargo test -p athena-gate`.
The code that selects the jobs a commit lands excludes jobs whose recorded outcome is not landed. A doc comment on it says why.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.
docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md or docs/decisions.md records the rule that only landed jobs form the chain.

out_of_scope: Changing how athena writes retries or previous_job.
Changing the rule that a squash cannot span a rules file.
Re-scoring or intervention handling (the earlier rrf8 fix).
Changing the policy test on docs wording.
